# Cully v0.3.0

Cully brings a local advisor, shared agent tools, and durable personal context together in one open source project.

- Run the Docker self-hosted stack with `cully setup codex`, directly from the installed CLI with no checkout. It generates service credentials in `~/.cully/config.json` and starts PostgreSQL, Mem0, the data API and MCP. Add `--oauth` after preparing an MCP Auth connector to enable team sign-in; MCP defaults to no OAuth.
- Store authoritative source records in plain PostgreSQL. Mem0 handles semantic memory and recall with its own pgvector database and a local open source embedding model.
- Pull matching MCP, data API and Mem0 images from GHCR for team deployments on Docker, Kubernetes or another container platform.
- Use MCP Auth's Go client SDK for MCP OAuth token validation. The private data API and Mem0 keep independent service credentials.
- Connect supported coding agents with `cully agent setup` and the combined Cully skill. Hosted agents can use the Cully MCP URL directly.
- Choose the individual or team path on the website. The team guide describes the service contract for Docker Compose, Kubernetes or an organization's container platform. Website and docs deploy through separate CI flows.
- Use separate lint, unit, integration, end-to-end, Trivy, and CodeQL checks in CI.

This release starts a fresh Cully data store. See the [self-hosting guide](https://docs.cully.net/hosting) and [configuration reference](https://docs.cully.net/configuration) before deploying.
